name: Amanda Thornbury
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Amanda is the founder of Intrinsic Healing Space, a private counselling practice built on the belief that people hold an intrinsic capacity for growth, healing and change. Amanda supports people experiencing workplace stress, burnout, anxiety, trauma recovery, overwhelm, loss of confidence and life transitions, as well as those times when life simply feels harder than it used to. Alongside counselling, Amanda is a We Al-li facilitator in Dadirri (deep listening) and culturally informed, trauma-integrated programs.

name: Elena Sansoni
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I am a PACFA Certified Practising Counsellor and child and family therapist, and the founder of North Star Child Therapy in Bayside Melbourne. I work with children, pre-teens, teenagers and parents, with a particular interest in anxiety, trauma, emotional regulation and behaviour. My approach is child-centred, trauma-informed and attachment-focused, drawing on evidence-based therapies including Child-Centred Play Therapy, CBT, ACT and Trauma-Focused CBT.

title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)

name: Cindy Melksham
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Cindy Melksham is a PACFA registered counsellor offering counselling for adolescents and adults both in-person in Footscray, Melbourne, and online across Australia. Cindy supports clients experiencing performance anxiety, social anxiety, trauma, stress and confidence challenges. Her approach is warm, collaborative and trauma-informed, with a focus on creating a safe space where clients feel understood and supported. These modalities can support deeper emotional regulation, trauma integration and lasting change.

name: Aimee Robinson
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Specialists in the treatment of depression and premenstrual disorders such PMDD (Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder) and PME (Premenstrual Exacerbation). Aimee has assisted many clients to uncover a meaningful life worth celebrating and sustained change. Aimee works with adults diagnosed with depression, adjustment disorder or experiencing symptoms of anxiety and depression and mood disorders such as: • Major Depressive Disorder • Acute Depression (mild, moderate, severe and extremely severe) • Pre-Menstrual Dysphoric Disorder • Adjustment Disorder (Life Transitions) • Grief and Loss Professional services offered: • Counselling and Psychotherapy Private Health Insurance rebates for eligible clients. • Medibank Private • AHM • HCF • Bupa • Police Health (ARHG) • Emergency Services Health (ARHG) To book an appointment click on the link: https://www.yourlifeincolour.com.au/book-online

name: Renee Spencer
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Renee is a trauma-informed mental health practitioner with lived experience of high-control groups, both religious and non-religious. Her work is client-centred and grounded in evidence-based frameworks. She cares deeply about helping people reclaim self-determination and build lives that feel authentic and truly their own.

name: Anna Badcock
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
address: Camberwell Therapy Hub, Suite 7 & 11, 493 Riversdale Rd
description: I am a trauma-informed, person-centred therapist with a Master of Counselling and Psychotherapy. As a PACFA accredited practitioner, I am committed to ethical practice, providing a supportive environment where you will feel heard and understood. I work collaboratively with each individual to provide therapy that is tailored to your needs and circumstances.
